title: Sentosa Cove Bungalow
subtitle: Ocean Drive
description:
An extraordinary waterfront bungalow set within the exclusive Sentosa Cove enclave — the only place in Singapore where foreigners may own landed property.

This magnificent 8,000 sqft detached villa sits on a rare corner plot with direct canal frontage and its own private jetty, offering berthing for a vessel up to 50 feet. The thoughtfully designed home features soaring double-volume ceilings, a grand entertaining pavilion, and seamless indoor-outdoor living spaces that open onto the private pool terrace.

The generously proportioned master suite occupies the entire upper floor east wing, with his-and-hers bathrooms, a private sitting room, and a wraparound balcony offering serene waterway views. A dedicated guest wing ensures privacy for visitors.
highlights: Private jetty – berth for vessel up to 50 feet
Only place in Singapore where foreigners can own landed property
Rare corner waterfront plot with canal frontage
Minutes to Sentosa's beaches, Resorts World & golf courses
nearbyMRT: Harbourfront MRT – 15 min drive / Sentosa Boardwalk
